    end
end)

function Buttons()
    spawn(function()
        _G.Buttons = true

        while _G.Buttons do
            pcall(function()
                local Character = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
                local g37
                if Character then
                    Character = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                end
                if not Character then
                    return
                end
                local Parent
                local n2 = 1e999
                for v28, v29 in pairs(workspace.TycoonButtons:GetDescendants()) do

                    local v30 = v29:IsA("TouchTransmitter")

                    if v30 then
                        v30 = v29.Parent:IsA("BasePart")
                    end

                    if v30 then
                        local Magnitude = (Character.Position - v29.Parent.Position).Magnitude

                        if Magnitude < n2 then
                            n2 = Magnitude
                            Parent = v29.Parent
                        end
                    end
                end
                if Parent then
                    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(Parent.Position) * CFrame.new(0, 5, 0)
                    firetouchinterest(Character, Parent, 0)
                    task.wait()
                    firetouchinterest(Character, Parent, 1)
                else
                    task.wait(4)
                    local v32 = false
                    local v33, v34, v35 = pairs(workspace.TycoonButtons:GetDescendants())
                    repeat
                        local v36

                        v35, v36 = v33(v34, v35)

                        if not v35 then
                            g37 = true
                        end

                        if g37 then
                            break
                        end

                        local v38 = v36:IsA("TouchTransmitter")

                        if v38 then
                            v38 = v36.Parent:IsA("BasePart")
                        end
                    until v38
                    if not g37 then
                        v32 = true
                    end
                    local v39 = not v32
                    if v39 then
                        v39 = _G.Buttons
                    end
                    if v39 then
                        Character.CFrame = workspace.ForestDen:GetPivot()
                    end
                end
                task.wait(1)
            end)
        end
    end)
end

function Rebirth()
    spawn(function()
        _G.Rebirth = true

        while _G.Rebirth do
            wait()
            pcall(function()
                if game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.HudGui.LeftContent.LeftButtons.RebirthGui.Content.Value.Text == "100%" then
                    game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.MotherTreeRebirth:FireServer()
                    wait(1)
                    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = workspace.ForestDen:GetPivot("WorldPivot")
                end

                wait(0.2)
            end)
        end
    end)
end
